rationale: The plan matches the reference: one DESeq2 fit of ~condition on all twelve samples, LRT against ~1 for the omnibus question, two Wald contrasts against an explicitly relevelled control from the same object with apeglm/ashr shrinkage and BH per contrast, and it keeps the LRT and pairwise results as separate answers. QC (VST PCA, correlation heatmap, size factors, dispersion plot) precedes the model with a stated no-silent-drop policy, and the prefilter (10 counts in 4 samples) is justified by the smallest group size. Deductions: the post hoc |log2FC|>=1 count is a threshold outside the test, sample-level outlier/shallow-library policy is only loosely stated, package versions are listed but not required in the report, and the enrichment step was not asked for and, while it names collections and a tested-gene universe, omits collection versions and a set-size window and ranks GSEA by shrunken LFC without justifying that choice.
